title: Nicholas Lloyd Smith
text:
I’m Nicholas Lloyd Smith, a PhD student in the Department of Economics at Emory University.


I’m an applied microeconomist working at the intersection of health and labor economics. I use causal inference methods to study risky behaviors and the policies that shape them.
A couple of projects in progress…


Male Entry to Female-Dominated Occupations
Effects of Sports Gambling Legalization on Health Outcomes





Interests: Ambling, Wikipedia rabbit holes, cheering on the Dawgs, and a full plate of TexMex food.
